description: This file declares internal API functions for the BREE (BSP Run-time Execution Engine) object, including methods for managing page processing, resource filtering, object invocation, and handling cooked pages within the system. It is intended for internal use within the BREE component of the system architecture.

methods.name: BreeSpoSetBeepEngineDesc
methods.description: Sets the Beep Engine description interface for the BREE component.

methods.name: BreeSpoGetBeepEngineDesc
methods.description: Retrieves the current Beep Engine description handle.

methods.name: BreeSpoCreateBeepEngineDesc
methods.description: Creates a new Beep Engine description handle.

methods.name: BreeSpoPreparePage
methods.description: Prepares a page for processing given its path and data.

methods.name: BreeSpoExecutePage
methods.description: Executes a prepared page within the system.

methods.name: BreeSpoSetStaticResEngineDesc
methods.description: Sets the Static Resource Engine description interface.

methods.name: BreeSpoGetStaticResEngineDesc
methods.description: Retrieves the current Static Resource Engine description handle.

methods.name: BreeSpoCreateStaticResEngineDesc
methods.description: Creates a new Static Resource Engine description handle.

methods.name: BreeSpoPrepareStaticRes
methods.description: Prepares static resource content for serving.

methods.name: BreeSpoExecuteStaticRes
methods.description: Executes the static resource response.

methods.name: BreeSpoQualifyPage
methods.description: Checks if the page path qualifies according to certain criteria and type.

methods.name: BreeSpoConvertPath
methods.description: Converts the original page path to a formal or standardized path.

methods.name: BreeSpoEngage
methods.description: Engages or activates the BREE component.

methods.name: BreeSpoCancel
methods.description: Cancels or deactivates the BREE component.

methods.name: BreeSpoSetBeepSerIf
methods.description: Sets the Beep Service Interface.

methods.name: BreeSpoSetBeepCspIf
methods.description: Sets the Beep CSP Interface.

methods.name: BreeSpoConfigResFilter
methods.description: Configures resource filtering mode and supervisor page content.

methods.name: BreeSpoRegResFilterDir
methods.description: Registers a directory for resource filtering.

methods.name: BreeSpoRegResFilterDirExemption
methods.description: Registers a directory exemption for resource filtering.

methods.name: BreeSpoRegResFilterFile
methods.description: Registers a file for resource filtering.

methods.name: BreeSpoRegResFilterFileExemption
methods.description: Registers a file exemption for resource filtering.

methods.name: BreeSpoGetFormalPagePath
methods.description: Retrieves the formalized page path from a given path.

methods.name: BreeSpoIsPagePathInFilterList
methods.description: Checks if a page path is in the resource filter list or exemption list.

methods.name: BreeSpoPrepareDFName
methods.description: Prepares a Derivative Filename from the page path.

methods.name: BreeSpoEnforceCache
methods.description: Enforces cache control for a specific page.

methods.name: BreeSpoCreateBreeSoaIf
methods.description: Creates a SOA interface object for BREE.

methods.name: BreeSpoSoaGetSlapObject
methods.description: Retrieves a SLAP object by name.

methods.name: BreeSpoSoaGetCookedPage
methods.description: Retrieves a cooked page handle given its path.

methods.name: BreeSpoSoaRetCookedPage
methods.description: Returns a cooked page handle.

methods.name: BreeSpoSoaGetCookedPageData
methods.description: Retrieves data stream and size of a cooked page.

methods.name: BreeSpoSoaInvokeObject
methods.description: Invokes a method on a specified object with given parameters.

methods.name: BreeSpoSoaIsBuiltInObject
methods.description: Checks if an object name corresponds to a built-in object.

methods.name: BreeSpoSoaWriteAString
methods.description: Writes an ASCII string to the SOA interface.

methods.name: BreeSpoSoaWriteBString
methods.description: Writes a binary string of defined length to the SOA interface.

methods.name: BreeSpoSoaIsInterrupted
methods.description: Checks if the SOA interface has been interrupted.
